title: Unit specialization of smooth tensor composition
statement: For finite coefficients and smooth composable morphisms, the unit-specialized canonical exceptional tensor composition equation displayed by AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.smoothTensorCompositionEquation holds for every etale derived-category input K.

proof.text: Expand the specified dualizing and exceptional composition comparisons. Apply rightDerivedUpperShriekTensorMap_comp through the compactification-tower projection compatibility, specialize at the coefficient unit, cancel by naturality, and apply projectionTensorMap_assoc and the left-unitor identity.

mathlib_searches.query: The tensor map of a composite right adjoint is the composite tensor map, and unit specialization is compatible with associativity

theorem smoothTensorCompositionEquation
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g] [HasCompactification (f ≫ g)]
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiCompact (f ≫ g)]
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Z) :
    (smoothDualizingCompMap A f g) ▷
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (f ≫ g)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K ≫
      Etale.dualizingComplexTensorMap A (f ≫ g) K ≫
        (smoothExceptionalCompIso A f g).hom.app K =
      (α_ (Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f)
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          (Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g))
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (f ≫ g)).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).hom ≫
      (Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ◁
        (((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
          (Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g)) ◁
            (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g).hom.app K ≫
          (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f
            (Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g)
            ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).inv ≫
          (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
            (Etale.dualizingComplexTensorMap A g K)) ≫
      Etale.dualizingComplexTensorMap A f
        ((Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).obj K)
